title: A Golf-Ball-Sized Octopus Can Kill 10 People

scenes.text: This octopus is the size of a golf ball. Its venom can kill ten people.
It is the blue-ringed octopus, and its venom is tetrodotoxin, the same poison as a pufferfish.
One milligram is enough to kill a person.
Its bite is often painless, so victims may not even know they were bitten.
There is no antidote. Doctors keep people alive by breathing for them until the poison wears off.
Small, quiet, and deadly. Ten people. Golf ball.

description:
A golf-ball-sized octopus carries enough venom to kill at least ten people.
The blue-ringed octopus uses tetrodotoxin, and there is no antidote, only life support until it wears off.
Would you have picked this one up?
first_comment: Its venom is made by bacteria living in the octopus. Would you swim in tide pools after learning this?
